info.title: OSCAR Next API
info.description: Local-first REST API for OSCAR Next CPAP data. OSCAR Next 2.2 adds a headless browser deployment for Raspberry Pi/Linux. Non-loopback binding requires a bearer token. File-system imports and removable-media watching are opt-in.

get.description: Contiguous therapy dates with included-session counts and mask-on usage hours. Includes summary-only sessions and zero-use days; excludes disabled sessions. Reads session metadata and slices without waveform, event or settings payloads.

get.summary: Raw-sample nightly channel statistics and leak duration
get.description: Enabled sessions only, clipped to therapy-day bounds and mask-on intervals. Duration-weighted nearest-rank percentiles; missing samples are excluded. Independent of chart visibility/decimation. Flow and uninterpreted respiratory event signals are excluded.

get.description: Expert supports explicit local Ollama or opt-in OpenAI/Groq processing. Groq has separate settings/check routes and needs no tunnel. Original configuration/status/tunnel routes configure OpenAI; Ollama uses existing Expert settings/check routes. OpenAI keeps store:false; Groq Chat Completions does not support that parameter. All providers use bounded read-only OSCAR tools and isolated ephemeral context. Credentials remain backend-only. Existing bearer authentication applies; cross-origin requests are rejected.

DailySummary.description: Therapy-day summary. Respiratory indices use detailed events when present; sessions without detailed respiratory events use stored STR rates weighted by included therapy hours, even when waveforms are available. Event counts contain detailed records only; STR does not provide RERA rates.

visible.description: Optional explicit visibility. When absent, use the graph default.

secondsAboveThreshold.description: Merged recorded elapsed time strictly above threshold

percentTherapyTimeAboveThreshold.description: 100 * secondsAboveThreshold / included mask-on therapy seconds; missing readings remain unknown

therapySeconds.description: Merged enabled mask-on elapsed time, including summary-only therapy

leak.description: Absent if no valid leak samples; never synthesize zero for missing recordings.

apiKey.description: Omit to preserve; null to remove. Never returned.

runtimeKey.description: Separate tunnel runtime credential. Omit to preserve; null to remove.

AIRequest.description: Shared Expert guided request or chat. provider is ollama, openai or groq; omitted provider inherits an existing conversation, or defaults to openai for backward compatibility. Providers cannot share conversation IDs/history. Each inclusive range is 1–90 therapy dates. New chat requires a range; follow-ups can inherit it. Ollama questions are limited to 2,000 characters and retain local compatibility/evidence validation. Groq uses backend-managed, scoped read-only tools without an OpenAI tunnel.

apiKey.description: Separate Groq API key. Omit to preserve; null to remove. Never returned.

GroqModelList.description: Active model IDs returned by Groq using the saved backend key. Listing does not establish chat/tool compatibility or account permissions; run the synthetic connection check.
